Restricted Sparring is a training course that
restricts the type of Pokémon you can use.\c
Select a type first, and then battle using up to
three Pokémon of that type.\c
No duplicate Pokémon or items are allowed.\c
If you can win five times in a row, you’ll
complete the training.\c
However, if you lose even once, the sparring
will end there!\c
You can restore your Pokémon between battles,
but only twice in total, so use the opportunities
very wisely.\c
That’s all!
